subject: POC incentive bridge and scope gating for Horizon Health
messages:

Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Horizon POC — request to bridge credits + acceptance gating

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The execs liked the latency/cost numbers — we have two small asks before we can commit to the MAP: a short bridge of additional pilot credits to cover an expanded data set (extra 48 hours of runs) and a clear pass/fail acceptance gating criteria so we can sign off quickly.

Current ask: +$6k in pilot credits to cover the additional tests and an extra two-week free trial window to let our clinical team validate prompts inside our sandbox.

Can Redwood confirm whether the credits can be front-loaded against the MAP milestones, and what the conversion price would be if we go to a 12-month commit after acceptance?

Appreciate a quick turn — Q3 procurement wants to lock vendors this month.

Best,
Jane
Director, Data Products
Horizon Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon POC — request to bridge credits + acceptance gating

Hi Jane — great to hear. Short answer: yes, we can do a temporary bridge of credits tied to MAP milestone acceptance and a conditional extension of the trial. Below is a proposed structure that balances your validation needs and our conversion economics.

Proposed MAP bridge (summary):
- Pilot credit bridge: Redwood provides $6,000 in pilot credits up front to cover the expanded runs. Credits are consumed on a first-in basis and tracked in the Console.
- Acceptance gating: We suggest two objective gates (A: accuracy on clinical prompt set >= 88% on defined metrics; B: latency P95 < 350ms in your sandbox with a 2k token window). Acceptance to be certified by Horizon’s data product lead and confirmed in a joint acceptance note.
- Trial extension: If acceptance testing needs >2 weeks beyond the original end date, Redwood will approve a one-time 14-day extension tied to the bridge credits consumption and milestone review.
- Conversion pricing: If Horizon converts within 30 days of acceptance, we’ll honor a stepped discount schedule for the first 12 months: 10% off list for a 12-month $350k commit, 15% for $500k+. These are tiered and subject to signature.

Operational notes:
- Credits will be applied to your account id and visible in Console billing > credits.
- If conversion is delayed beyond 60 days, bridge credits are considered a one-time incentive and will not roll into committed spend.

I’ll loop in Grace (customer success) for acceptance orchestration and Vivek on pricing approval. Grace — can you own the acceptance checklist and schedule a joint test window? Vivek — can we confirm the pricing ladder and any limits on stacking with other discounts?

I’ll put this in a one-page MAP and send for countersignature.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

1) The clinical team will need at least 4 full days of runs during the expanded window; can the credits be guaranteed not to expire mid-run?
2) For acceptance, can we add a qualitative review step for hallucination examples (we'll provide the rubric)?

If we can get those added, I think we can commit to the MAP and the acceptance timeline. Also, can you confirm who signs the MAP on Redwood's side? Our legal prefers a named approver and will want the conversion pricing included in an appendix.

Tom

Hi Tom & Jane — looping back with the updated MAP and approvals.

Edits made per your notes:
- Pilot credits: $6,000 applied up front to your Horizon test account. Credits are valid for 45 days from issuance and we will not retire a running test mid-job; Console will show credit consumption in real time.
- Acceptance gating: Added qualitative hallucination rubric (Section 2b) — Horizon to provide rubric by 6/17; Grace will consolidate results.
- Trial extension: Single 14-day extension approved; extension triggers only if acceptance tests are incomplete after the current trial end date.
- Signatory: Vivek Kulkarni (VP, Revenue) will be Redwood's named approver for the MAP and pricing appendix.
- Pricing appendix: Conversion pricing for 12-month commits documented (10% for $350k, 15% for $500k+) and included in the attached signed_map_bridge.pdf for legal.

Attached: signed_map_bridge.pdf (Redwood internal sign-off included). Please review and reply with a countersigned PDF or approval note so we can push the credits and schedule the acceptance window.

Thanks — Grace
